contradicting_or_limiting: No control group; time, regression and expectancy confounding
Salivary time profile is not cortisol production rate

evidence_items.text: Ghaly & Teplitz 2004: uncontrolled n=12 with sleep dysfunction, pain and stress; night cortisol pattern and subjective measures reportedly improved over 8 weeks.
evidence_items.why_it_matters: The only direct evidence for this proposition; no control group, no blinding and no validated endpoint.

evidence_items.text: A time-specific salivary cortisol profile is not equivalent to general cortisol production; the prohibited transition is pattern to general production lowering.
evidence_items.why_it_matters: The endpoint the wording names was not measured.

evidence_items.text: No controlled independent replication of the H02 cortisol observation was located.
evidence_items.why_it_matters: A single uncontrolled result carries no replication support.

evidence.evidence_sufficiency_rationale: One uncontrolled 12-participant observation cannot support a physiological production claim.
supporting: H02 night-time salivary cortisol pattern change (uncontrolled, n=12)

detected.rationale: The sole supporting study has no control arm; observed change cannot be separated from time, regression or expectancy.
A change in a night-time salivary profile is presented as lowered cortisol production.
An uncontrolled biomarker observation is offered for a specific physiological production claim.

verdict.classification_note: A forensic classification describes the relationship between the claim and the cited evidence. It is not, by itself, proof that the claim is factually false.
verdict.confidence_interpretation: Model's self-assessed probability that its own primary classification is correct (Phase 6.1 semantics). Not a calibrated probability.
verdict.verdict_summary: The entire evidence base for this claim is one uncontrolled 12-participant study reporting a night-time salivary cortisol pattern change. A time-specific salivary profile is not a measure of cortisol production, and no controlled independent replication exists.
verdict.verdict_title: Claim goes beyond the available evidence
